description: Land Acquisition - Divulapitiya, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a government infrastructure project. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, their locations, claimants, and extents, along with procedures for compensation claims. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with property ownership transfers and land acquisition procedures.
